stories.Headline: Meta ordered to pay $567 million in New Mexico for teen mental health fund
stories.Summary:
A New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $567 million into a teen mental health fund and implement safety changes for young users on Facebook and Instagram. Judge Bryan Biedscheid ruled that Meta created a public nuisance by designing addictive products for children and failing to protect them from sexual exploitation. The decision came five months after a jury had already ordered Meta to pay $375 million for misrepresenting platform safety to young users.

The ruling requires Meta to enforce monthly usage limits for teens, restrict notifications, tighten controls on adult contact with minors, and prevent children from engaging in romantic interactions with AI chatbots for five years. Meta stated it will appeal and defend its record on teen safety. The case reflects a broader trend, with over 40 states and more than 1,300 school districts pursuing similar lawsuits against social media companies seeking damages and product changes.

stories.Headline: Why 3D Spaces Interior Designing Company is Leading the Future of Home and Office Design with Advanced Technology
stories.Summary:
# Summary

3D Spaces Interior Designing Company is using artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and augmented reality to transform how homes and offices are designed and furnished. The company employs AI to analyze customer preferences and optimize space usage, achieving an 80% initial design match with client needs. They offer virtual reality experiences that let customers visualize their future spaces before construction begins, and augmented reality tools that allow real-time design adjustments through smartphones or tablets.

The company provides complete turnkey interior design services from concept through completion, supported by their own in-house team and furniture factory to ensure quality control and on-time delivery. 3D Spaces operates across Delhi NCR and nationally, positioning itself as a leader in combining technology with interior design expertise. Their integrated approach handles both residential and commercial projects, including smart office furniture with features like adjustable desks and charging stations designed for modern work environments.

stories.Headline: Delhi Legislative Assembly invites Digital India BHASHINI Division to conduct pilot trial of AI-powered live transcription, translation system
stories.Summary:
The Delhi Legislative Assembly has invited the Digital India BHASHINI Division to test an artificial intelligence system that can transcribe and translate legislative proceedings in real time. Assembly Speaker Vijender Gupta stated the goal is to improve efficiency and accessibility in legislative management. This marks the first pilot deployment of the live transcription and translation system in any legislative house across India.

BHASHINI, India's national language translation mission launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in July 2022, uses artificial intelligence to provide digital public services in multiple Indian languages. The system currently powers over 800 government websites, processes more than 20 million daily inferences, and supports 36 Indian text languages along with 23 Indian voice languages. The Assembly will evaluate the pilot trial's performance and gather feedback before deciding on wider deployment across other branches of the organization.

stories.Headline: SFO Tech Powers Kochi's Entry into High-End AI Hardware
stories.Summary:
SFO Technologies, the electronics division of India's NeST Group, has partnered with American company Smart IOPS to manufacture specialized AI data storage hardware in Kochi, Kerala. This collaboration integrates Smart IOPS' proprietary controller technology into production lines to create high-performance solid state drives needed for artificial intelligence systems, data centers, and supercomputers. The move represents a significant advancement for India's manufacturing capabilities, as producing AI-grade hardware demands greater precision, complex circuit design, and advanced thermal management compared to traditional device assembly.

The partnership supports India's self-reliance initiative, known as Atmanirbhar Bharat, while positioning the country as a dependable hub for AI infrastructure manufacturing in Asia. According to NeST Group leadership, this achievement demonstrates India's ability to produce critical computing technology domestically. Smart IOPS' co-founder emphasized that manufacturing in Kochi proves India can now provide the reliable, high-precision supply chain required for world-class AI computing, strengthening India's position in the global semiconductor industry.

stories.Headline: Chitkara University Hosted the AIKosh University Engagement Programme Under IndiaAI Mission, 250 CSE-AI Students Participated
stories.Summary:
Chitkara University in Punjab participated in the AIKosh University Engagement Programme, a government initiative under the IndiaAI Mission. More than 250 students from the university's Computer Science Engineering with Artificial Intelligence program took part in the program on August 6, 2026, gaining access to national-level artificial intelligence resources, industry tools, and emerging practices. The university has now been onboarded as a contributor to AIKosh.

The IndiaAI Mission was approved by the Indian government in March 2024 to establish India as a global artificial intelligence leader by promoting technological self-reliance and responsible AI development. AIKosh serves as a comprehensive platform providing datasets, AI models, tools, and other resources to support AI adoption in academic institutions. Through the University Engagement Programme, organizers aim to nurture emerging talent and enable students and researchers to contribute to India's expanding artificial intelligence sector.

stories.Headline: Things to do in Sudbury, Aug. 8 to Aug. 11 | Mid-North Monitor
stories.Summary:
Sudbury offers numerous cultural activities from August 8 to 11. The Her Northern Voice Music Festival features 43 artists performing across seven venues through August 9, with headliners including Lee Aaron, Susan Aglukark, and Chantal Kreviazuk. Three theatrical productions are running, including Come From Away at the Sudbury Theatre Centre through August 22, City Medicine and Lungs at YES Theatre through August 29, and Little Women at Thorneloe University through August 9. Multiple art exhibitions are on display, including work by Jay Favot at Perivale Gallery, Shirley Rose Cockburn at Pinchman's, and Ivan Wheale's final exhibition also at Perivale Gallery.

Additional events include the Sudbury Market operating Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., the free Peter Schneider Concert Series featuring live music every Sunday at 7 p.m. at Bell Park, and Science North's Earth Works exhibition. The Art Gallery of Sudbury is celebrating 30 years of the Myths and Mirrors program. Theater and film options continue throughout the weekend, and Canadian Blood Services accepts plasma donations at their Sudbury location on Lasalle Boulevard.

stories.Headline: IT News Online - Ai4 2026 Sets New Records With 50% Attendance Growth as More Than 12,000 Global AI Leaders from 100 Countries Gather in Las Vegas to Explore the Future of Artificial Intelligence
stories.Summary:
The Ai4 2026 artificial intelligence conference in Las Vegas concluded with record-breaking participation, attracting over 12,000 attendees from 100 countries. The ninth annual event experienced a 50 percent increase in attendance compared to 2025, growing from 8,000 to more than 12,000 participants. The exhibition expanded significantly with 470 exhibitors and sponsors, nearly double the previous year's 250, while startup companies showcasing their technologies nearly tripled from 25 to 66 companies.

The three-day conference featured more than 1,000 speakers across 80 educational tracks covering topics including foundation models, robotics, cybersecurity, healthcare, and AI governance. Notable highlights included a panel discussion called "The Architects of Intelligence" featuring Nobel Prize recipient Geoffrey Hinton, researcher Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng. Major technology companies including AMD, AWS, NVIDIA, Google Cloud, and IBM participated as exhibitors. The event also drew a record 225 credentialed journalists. Organizers announced that the 2027 edition will take place August 3-5 at the same Las Vegas venue.
